name: Beatriz Oliveira
bio:
Beatriz's fascination with motorsport began early, fueled by her father's passion for rallying. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Porto, she immersed herself in the world of competitive racing. Beatriz quickly gained experience in various roles, from data analysis to trackside support, honing her technical skills. Her meticulous approach and innate ability to optimize performance led to rapid promotions, eventually landing her the role of chief engineer at a renowned Portuguese racing team.

Beatriz is known for her data-driven approach and her collaborative leadership style. She believes in fostering a team environment where every member feels empowered to contribute their expertise. She is always looking for innovative ways to improve car performance, pushing the boundaries of engineering within the regulations. Her experience has made her a highly sought after engineer, and she is now looking to take her career to the next level.

What sets Beatriz apart is her blend of technical expertise and exceptional management skills. She excels at translating complex technical data into actionable strategies, ensuring that the team operates at peak efficiency and achieves consistent results. Her ability to inspire and motivate those around her makes her a valuable asset to any racing team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy, often pulled back in a practical ponytail
physical.description: Beatriz is of average height and has a focused, intense gaze that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Portuguese coffee before every race.
